name: Inner Mongolia Berun Chemical Company Limited
summary: Inner Mongolia Berun Chemical Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells soda ash, baking soda, fertilizers, and other chemical products in China. It operates through Soda Ash; Fertilizer and Other Agricultural Production Materials; and Other segments. The company offers soda ash for use in glass applications, as well as for the metallurgy, chemical, light industry, daily chemical, and food industries; baking soda for use in food, feed, pharmaceuticals, daily chemical cleaning, environmental desulfurization, firefighting, printing and dyeing, rubber, leather, metallurgy, water treatment, and other applications; urea for use in agricultural fertilizers, melamine, urea…
